caption: “Paper Birch (Betula papyrifera) Botanical and Commercial Range,” from Birch, American Woods (Washington, D.C.: U.S. Dept. of Agriculture, Forest Service, 1940), p. 15.
alt: A map of the eastern United States with the paper birch’s range hatched across the northern states from Minnesota to Maine, darkest in the north woods and northern New England, where most was cut commercially.
bibliography: United States Forest Service. "Paper Birch (Betula papyrifera) Botanical and Commercial Range." Birch, American Woods, U.S. Department of Agriculture, Forest Service, 1940.
